meta.name: Club Friday Season 15: Moments & Memories
meta.description: 6 stories about "Moments and Memories" in the lives of different people.

videos.title: Deepest Love Episode 1
videos.overview:
Renee is a lesbian who's heartbroken when her ex Punpun leaves her for a man. Despite knowing that Nart himself is gay, Renee decides she wants to marry him, believing that her love for him would fix everything. Renee has to give up and accept that there are limits when it comes to love. She allows a third person, Songpol, to live in their house.

Rey and Punpun separate, leaving Rey feeling depressed. However, she finds comfort with her new acquaintance, Nart.

videos.title: Deepest Love Episode 2
videos.overview: After Punpun posts photos online of Nart and Rey, they two decide to move in together and give their relationship a chance.

videos.title: Deepest Love Episode 3
videos.overview: Nart and Rey get married, but Nart suspects Rey's intentions were more focused on her relationship with her ex-girlfriend.

videos.title: Deepest Love Episode 4
videos.overview: A new suitor approaches along with tragedy interrupting Rey's plans for a family.

videos.title: Love Never Dies Episode 1
videos.overview: Rinthan and Saphol are each others' first loves. They'd planned their entire lives together: their marriage, home, children. Everything's shattered when Saphol suddenly passes away in an accident. Shocked an devesatated, Rinthan makes an earnest wish for Saphol to return so they can live their happy future and she begins to live her life as if he were still alive. With Saphol's image clinging to her, Rinthan cannot live a normal life, cannot begin to start a new life with someone new. Always by her side is her sister Paithong. Paithong is in love with Joong who's in her faculty. It's a different kind of love, one where feelings are hidden, or they manifest in quarelling. Rinthan wonders why a love like hers and Saphol's had to be broken when love that doesn't look like love perseveres.

videos.title: Love Begins Episode 1
videos.overview:
The relationship between two families begins with the friendship of one's daughter and the other's son. As time goes on, Namkhing and Foon's friendship morphs into first love. Spending increased time together, they eventually have the cahnce to take a family trip together.

Soon, the relationship between Namkhing's mother Chayanut and Foon's father Sahat crosses a line. Both families are shaken by the realisation that Chayanut and Sahat had had an affari resulting in a pregnancy. Despite it all, the couples chose to stay by each other so as not to break up their families.

videos.title: Love and War Episode 1
videos.overview:
A married couple decides to go their separate ways because the wife has grown tired of being a homemaker. She had to give up her career to care for her husband and daughter, and she wants to start fresh. In her pursuit of a new life, she leaves her daughter in her husband's care. The single father struggled to juggle his newfound responsibilities, and their daughter suffers the absence of her mother's love, placing blame on her father for the situation. This leads to a conflict between them. However, with time, Khid and Kaewsai manage to resolve their differences and develop a loving relationship.

Unexpectedly, Maysa returns, wanting to reclaim custody of her daughter, sparking a new battle for their child's custody. This battle is rooted in love but proves just as destructive as any other war.

videos.title: Conditional Love Episode 1
videos.overview: Thanya is a sassy girl, along with her best friends, Joenjoen and Maple. These girls are all party animals. They all dream of finding true love even though their lifestyles seems to like otherwise. Thanya found Pita through a dating app and falls in love. Thanya doesn’t hide the fact that she already has someone she loves since her childhood and their parents are about to arrange their marriage soon.

videos.title: Fading Love Episode 1
videos.overview:
After accepting that the love in his marriage has faded, Chatphol tries everything to divorce his wife Panwat because this fifty-year-old man has fallen for Jenny, thirty years his junior. Panwat is devestated, a twenty-year marriage shattered in the blink of an eye. No one is more affected than Atom and Pétanque, their beloved twin sons.

The twins are alwasy fighting as their parents seem to care more about Pétanque, the younger and weaker of the two. Despite the tension between them, the two have to work together if they want to fix their problem.
